summary: Most OpenProject fixes live in the openproject monorepo. Rich-text and editor issues may belong in commonmark-ckeditor-build or op-blocknote-extensions. Icon and design-system issues may belong in openproject-octicons or primer_view_components.

repos.name: openproject
repos.description: OpenProject monorepo (Rails backend + Angular frontend). Set OP_REPO_PATH to a local checkout to seed a faster clone.

repos.name: commonmark-ckeditor-build
repos.description: CKEditor 5 build powering OpenProject's CommonMark rich-text editor.

repos.name: op-blocknote-extensions
repos.description: BlockNote editor extensions used by the next-gen rich-text editor.

repos.name: openproject-octicons
repos.description: OpenProject's Octicons icon set (SVG sources + generated assets).

repos.name: primer_view_components
repos.description: Primer ViewComponents (design system) used in the Rails-rendered UI.
